The '''Vulcusion sector''' was located in<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="Western Reaches" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Vulcusion system/Legends|Vulcusion system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which shared its name with the confrontation known as the [[Battle of Vulcusion]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Vulcusion [[Sector/Legends|sector]] bordered the [[Alchenaut sector/Legends|Alchenaut sector]] eastward and formed a four-way border with the [[Hakartha sector/Legends|Hakartha]], [[Bes Ber Bikade sector/Legends|Bes Ber Bikade]], and [[Rocantor sector/Legends|Rocantor sectors]] at its northwestern reaches. To the south, the Vulcusion sector constituted the Expansion Region's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] boundary with [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Eidoloni sector/Legends|Eidoloni]] and [[Spirva sector/Legends|Spirva sectors]].<ref name="Expansion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vulcusion sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://web.archive.org/web/20170806141020/https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid squares L-15 and L-16.<ref name="Expansion" />
